info.title: Pinpoint Jobs API: Open Roles from Pinpoint Career Sites
info.description:
Open roles from any Pinpoint career site as JSON, with department, location, pay and description.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/pinpoint-career-site-jobs (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Read public Pinpoint job feeds with department, employment type, location, workplace type, compensation, description and job URL. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

careerUrls.title: Pinpoint career URLs
careerUrls.description: Public Pinpoint career roots or jobs.rss feed URLs.

query.title: Keyword filter
query.description: Optional words that must all appear in normalized public job data.

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Keep roles whose public location or workplace field says remote.

includeDescription.title: Include descriptions
includeDescription.description: Include the clean public RSS description.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of normalized records saved to the default dataset. A request returns 20 rows at most.

201.description: The results, one object per row.
